<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
$get = function ( $id ) { return function_exists( 'wp_get_ability' ) ? wp_get_ability( $id ) : null; };
$smoke = $get( 'smoke/echo' );
$exec = null;
if ( $smoke ) { $exec = $smoke->execute( array( 'msg' => 'hi' ) ); if ( is_wp_error( $exec ) ) { $exec = 'WP_Error: ' . $exec->get_error_code(); } }
$result = array(
  'wpai_version' => defined( 'WPAI_VERSION' ) ? WPAI_VERSION : null,
  'abstract_feature' => class_exists( 'WordPress\AI\Abstracts\Abstract_Feature' ),
  'smoke_ability' => (bool) $smoke,
  'smoke_exec' => $exec,
  'read_content' => (bool) $get( 'core/read-content' ),
  'read_users' => (bool) $get( 'core/read-users' ),
  'read_settings' => (bool) $get( 'core/read-settings' ),
  'suggest_reply' => (bool) $get( 'ai/suggest-reply' ),
);
file_put_contents( '/wordpress/wp-content/mu-plugins/result.json', json_encode( $result, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT ) );
echo json_encode( $result );
